name: dnest1
style: Flat 2D side view illustration from a children's picture book about dinosaurs. {subject}, the whole animal visible, cute and friendly with a happy face, isolated and centered on a solid uniform pure chroma-key magenta (#FF00FF) background. No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only. Every colour has a second, slightly darker flat shade on its lower or shadow side, giving a simple two-tone shading. Bright colours, clean simple shapes. No pink, purple or magenta anywhere on the animal. No text, no ground, no grass, no eggs, no nest, no shadow, no scenery.

items.maiasaura: A single mother Maiasaura duck billed dinosaur standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a wide flat duck like beak, a small bony bump crest above the eyes, a gentle kind smile, a long thick tail held straight out, olive green skin with a light yellow belly and darker green stripes on its back
items.oviraptor: A single Oviraptor dinosaur standing on two legs facing right seen from the side, a bird like dinosaur with a short parrot like beak, a tall round crest on its head, both feathered arms spread out wide like little wings, long legs, a feathery tail, orange and yellow feathers with blue feather tips on the arms
items.protoceratops: A single Protoceratops dinosaur standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a small chubby dinosaur with a parrot like beak, a wide flat bony frill behind its head, no horns, a short thick tail, sandy tan skin with a cream belly and brown spots
items.compsognathus: A single tiny Compsognathus dinosaur running on two long thin legs facing right seen from the side, a slim little lizard like dinosaur with a small pointed head, big eyes, short arms and a very long thin tail held straight out, bright green skin with a yellow belly and dark green stripes
